name: nontrivial zeros of Dirichlet L-functions
statement: rho=beta+i gamma with L(rho,chi)=0 in the critical strip
claim_ceiling: No zero-location theorem is produced by residue-phase encoding.

name: character logarithmic derivative
claim_ceiling: Does not provide analytic continuation or zero recovery.

name: character-weighted Chebyshev observable
claim_ceiling: Finite values do not determine all L-function zeros.

name: explicit formula for psi(x,chi)
statement: psi(x,chi) is expressed through main/pole terms when present, sums over zeros rho of L(s,chi), gamma-factor terms, and controlled remainder terms
claim_ceiling: Not derivable from finite character orthogonality alone.

name: explicit formula in arithmetic progressions
statement: psi(x;q,a)=phi(q)^{-1} sum_chi conjugate(chi(a)) psi(x,chi), followed by the explicit formulas for the character channels
claim_ceiling: The Fourier reconstruction is exact; the zero terms require independent analytic certificates.

name: principal character pole boundary
statement: The principal character channel carries the main term through the pole inherited from zeta; nonprincipal primitive channels are entire after completion
claim_ceiling: Residue-channel data alone does not establish the pole structure.

name: exceptional real zero boundary
statement: A possible real zero beta close to 1 for a real character can dominate an arithmetic-progression error term
claim_ceiling: Finite residue bias neither proves nor excludes an exceptional zero.

name: GRH error scale for arithmetic progressions
statement: Under GRH, character zero contributions have beta=1/2 and yield square-root-scale error terms up to logarithmic factors
claim_ceiling: Conditional statement only; no GRH progress.

name: zero-driven residue-channel oscillation
statement: Zeros enter PVG only through analytically supplied oscillatory coefficients attached to residue-phase observables
claim_ceiling: PVG channel geometry does not independently recover beta, gamma, or multiplicity.

name: information lost by finite channel observation
statement: A finite table of psi(x;q,a) loses the global complex-analytic continuation, infinitely many zeros, multiplicities, and tail control
claim_ceiling: No inverse zero reconstruction from finite samples.

name: finite zero verification does not prove GRH
statement: Checking zeros up to height T cannot establish the universal statement for all zeros

name: finite AP balance does not locate zeros
statement: Observed balance of psi(x;q,a) for finitely many x and q does not imply a zero-free region or critical-line theorem
